title.en: Chapter 2 — A Servant to His Liking

book_meta.work: Le Tour du monde en quatre-vingts jours
book_meta.author: Jules Verne

sentences.en: Passepartout went round the house.
Everything clean, orderly, in its place.
And above every door, a clock.
And all the clocks at the same time, to the second.
And in his room, he found a paper on the table.
The day's programme, from morning to evening.
8:23, tea and toast.
9:37, shaving water. 9:40, shaving.
And so on until midnight.
Passepartout said: this is it.
This man is like a machine.
And I love machines.

sentences.ar: وفكر بسيده القديم بفرنسا، اللي كان يغير رأيه كل ساعة.
sentences.en: And thought of his old master in France, who changed his mind every hour.
And felt that at last he would rest.
As for Fogg, he was at the Reform Club.

sentences.ar: بيت كبير، فيه مكتبة، ومطعم، وأوضة ورق.
sentences.en: A big house, with a library, a restaurant, a card room.
And its members the richest men in London.

sentences.ar: أكل فوغ غداه، وقرا جريدة التايمز، وبعدين جريدة تانية.
sentences.en: Fogg ate his lunch, read the Times, and then another paper.

sentences.ar: وبالمسا، قعد على طاولة الورق، مع خمسة من أصحابه.
sentences.en: And in the evening, he sat at the card table, with five of his friends.

sentences.ar: مهندس، وصاحب مصنع بيرة، ومدير بنك، وتاجرين.
sentences.en: An engineer, a brewer, a bank director, two merchants.
And these were all the friends he had in the world.
And that day, no one was playing.
Everyone was talking about one piece of news.
The robbery of the Bank of England.

sentences.ar: خمسة وخمسين ألف جنيه، من على طاولة، بوضح النهار.
sentences.en: Fifty-five thousand pounds, from a counter, in broad daylight.

sentences.ar: والحرامي، حسب الوصف، رجل محترم، لابس منيح.
sentences.en: And the thief, by the description, a gentleman, well dressed.
And the police had sent men to every port.
The engineer said: they will catch him.
The bank director said: no.
The world is big.

sentences.ar: قال فوغ، وهو بيوزع الورق: كانت كبيرة.
sentences.en: Fogg said, dealing the cards: it was big.
